propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the differ's local and Jira-side comment body keys use different decoders: local routes through AdfCodec.normalize_outbound (markdown round trip with escaping), Jira through adf_to_text (no escaping), causing dedup mismatches on in-limit markdown bodies
The markdown round trip escapes markdown-active characters and rewrites autolinks, while the Jira-side decode does not, producing divergent keys for the same landed comment body

The send path encodes a decorated body; markdown_to_adf's content-preservation fallback degrades the whole document to plain text encoding when HTML comments are present, while the local key round-trips the undecorated body, deepening divergence
The fix derives the local key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same decoder as the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry
Root cause introduced by commit 27b868ba55 (789c-1251-fc21-4cf6), which moved send path to codec ADF encoding of decorated body while leaving Jira-side decode on normalize_rich_text/adf_to_text
The solution adds _IdentityCodec.to_wire identity and updates _diff_comments to use one-decoder form: _normalize_comment_body(codec.to_wire(_decorate_outbound_comment(sanitizer.fit_comment(body))))
